title: Wall Mount Shower Curtain Brackets And Rod 1-Inch Solid Brass Pair, Prestige Regal Collection | Fire Engine Red | Allied Brass
short_title: Shower Curtain Brackets And Rod 1-Inch Wall Mount Pair | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade your bathroom shower setup with wall mount shower curtain rod brackets built for use with any 1-inch diameter shower rod in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space. Crafted from solid brass and designed to coordinate with the Prestige Regal Collection for a cohesive, transitional bathroom hardware look.

Highlights:
- Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Sold as a pair to support one shower rod (rod sold separately)
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished wall-mounted installation
- Multiple designer finish options available to coordinate with versatile bath accessories

Specs & Details:
- Product: Shower curtain rod brackets (pair)
- Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screws
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions (each): 3 in L x 3 in W x 2.25 in H; 2 in projection
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included: Brackets and installation hardware (shower rod sold separately)
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
